/**
 * FROZEN acceptance spec — loop `.cursor/loops/lessons-file`.
 *
 * verify.sh copies this file to `src/loop/__acceptance__/lessonsFile.acceptance.test.ts`,
 * typechecks it with the repo, runs it with vitest, then deletes the copy.
 * Its sha256 is pinned in verify.sh. Do not edit it; make the code satisfy it.
 */
import fs from 'node:fs'
import os from 'node:os'
import path from 'node:path'
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { repoProfileSchema } from '../../context/repoProfile.js'
import { runAgentLoop } from '../agentLoop.js'
import { loopConfigSchema } from '../loopConfig.js'
import { FROZEN_LOOP_BASENAMES } from '../loopFrozenFiles.js'
import {
  LESSONS_FILENAME,
  LESSONS_MAX_CHARS,
  buildLessonsPromptSection,
  lessonsPath,
  readLessons,
  recordGreenRunLessons,
} from '../loopLessons.js'
import { buildAgentLoopPrompt } from '../loopPrompt.js'
import { runVerifyCommand, type VerifyResult } from '../loopVerify.js'

vi.mock('../loopVerify.js', () => ({ runVerifyCommand: vi.fn() }))
vi.mock('../loopGit.js', async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('../loopGit.js')>()
  return {
    ...actual,
    captureGitWorkspaceSnapshot: vi.fn(() => ({
      branch: 'main',
      shortSha: 'abc1234',
      diffStat: '',
      statusPorcelain: '',
    })),
  }
})

const mockedVerify = vi.mocked(runVerifyCommand)
const VERIFY_CMD = 'bash .cursor/loops/acc/verify.sh'

let loopDir: string
let repoRoot: string

function pass(): VerifyResult {
  return { complete: true, command: VERIFY_CMD, exitCode: 0, stdout: 'all green', stderr: '', reason: 'Verifier passed (exit 0).' }
}

function fail(stdout: string): VerifyResult {
  return { complete: false, command: VERIFY_CMD, exitCode: 1, stdout, stderr: '', reason: 'Verifier failed (exit 1).' }
}

function bundle(overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return {
    loopDir,
    goal: 'Acceptance goal for lessons-file.',
    config: loopConfigSchema.parse({
      verify: VERIFY_CMD,
      maxIterations: 3,
      delayMs: 0,
      postQualityReview: false,
      reviewGate: false,
      syncOnSuccess: false,
      stagnationThreshold: 0,
      exportPack: false,
      exportRunReport: false,
      exportTranscript: false,
      // lessons is opt-in (default off since review of #47); these wiring tests opt in.
      lessons: true,
      ...overrides,
    }),
    logPath: path.join(loopDir, 'log.ndjson'),
  }
}

function ctx() {
  return { repoRoot, profile: repoProfileSchema.parse({ syncCommand: null }) }
}

function session() {
  const prompts: string[] = []
  const runIterationPrompt = vi.fn(async (prompt: string) => {
    prompts.push(prompt)
    return { text: 'done' }
  })
  return { prompts, workerSession: { runIterationPrompt, dispose: vi.fn(async () => undefined) } }
}

function count(haystack: string, needle: string): number {
  return haystack.split(needle).length - 1
}

const git = { branch: 'main', shortSha: 'abc1234', diffStat: '', statusPorcelain: '' }

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.clearAllMocks()
  loopDir = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'acc-lessons-loop-'))
  repoRoot = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'acc-lessons-repo-'))
})

describe('lessons-file: module contract', () => {
  it('names the file lessons.md in the loop dir and freezes it against workers', () => {
    expect(LESSONS_FILENAME).toBe('lessons.md')
    expect(lessonsPath(loopDir)).toBe(path.join(loopDir, 'lessons.md'))
    expect(FROZEN_LOOP_BASENAMES as readonly string[]).toContain('lessons.md')
  })

  it('is opt-in: lessons defaults to false in loop.json', () => {
    expect(loopConfigSchema.parse({ verify: VERIFY_CMD }).lessons).toBe(false)
  })

  it('reads nothing when the file is absent or blank', () => {
    expect(readLessons(loopDir)).toBeUndefined()
    fs.writeFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), '   \n')
    expect(readLessons(loopDir)).toBeUndefined()
  })

  it('records the verify command and the first output line of each failure overcome', () => {
    recordGreenRunLessons(loopDir, {
      verifyCommand: VERIFY_CMD,
      iterations: 2,
      failuresOvercome: [fail('\nFAIL src/a.test.ts > parses dates\nAssertionError: expected 1 to be 2')],
    })
    const text = readLessons(loopDir)
    expect(text).toBeDefined()
    expect(text).toContain(VERIFY_CMD)
    expect(text).toContain('FAIL src/a.test.ts > parses dates')
  })

  it('is idempotent: the same green run recorded twice does not duplicate facts', () => {
    const run = {
      verifyCommand: VERIFY_CMD,
      iterations: 2,
      failuresOvercome: [fail('FAIL gotcha-dedupe-7')],
    }
    recordGreenRunLessons(loopDir, run)
    recordGreenRunLessons(loopDir, run)
    const text = readLessons(loopDir) ?? ''
    expect(count(text, 'gotcha-dedupe-7')).toBe(1)
    expect(count(text, VERIFY_CMD)).toBe(1)
  })

  it('stays bounded and keeps the newest gotchas', () => {
    for (let run = 0; run < 50; run++) {
      recordGreenRunLessons(loopDir, {
        verifyCommand: VERIFY_CMD,
        iterations: 3,
        failuresOvercome: [0, 1, 2, 3].map((k) => fail(`FAIL gotcha-${run}-${k} ${'x'.repeat(120)}`)),
      })
    }
    const text = fs.readFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), 'utf8')
    expect(text.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(LESSONS_MAX_CHARS)
    expect(text).toContain('gotcha-49-3')
    expect(text).not.toContain('gotcha-0-0 ')
  })

  it('renders a prompt section in the stable head, before the workspace block', () => {
    const section = buildLessonsPromptSection('LESSON-ALPHA')
    expect(section).toContain('## Lessons from earlier green runs')
    expect(section).toContain('LESSON-ALPHA')

    const prompt = buildAgentLoopPrompt({
      goal: 'g',
      iteration: 1,
      maxIterations: 2,
      git,
      lastVerify: null,
      priorFailures: [],
      lessons: 'LESSON-ALPHA',
    })
    const head = prompt.indexOf('## Lessons from earlier green runs')
    expect(head).toBeGreaterThan(-1)
    expect(head).toBeLessThan(prompt.indexOf('## Workspace (git)'))

    const without = buildAgentLoopPrompt({ goal: 'g', iteration: 1, maxIterations: 2, git, lastVerify: null, priorFailures: [] })
    expect(without).not.toContain('## Lessons from earlier green runs')
  })
})

describe('lessons-file: wired into runAgentLoop', () => {
  it('writes lessons.md after a green run, with the loop verify command and the gotcha it overcame', async () => {
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValueOnce(fail('FAIL gotcha-one: missing export')).mockReturnValueOnce(pass())
    const { workerSession } = session()
    const result = await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle(), workerSession })
    expect(result.complete).toBe(true)
    const text = readLessons(loopDir) ?? ''
    expect(text).toContain(VERIFY_CMD)
    expect(text).toContain('gotcha-one: missing export')
  })

  it('writes nothing when the run never goes green', async () => {
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValue(fail('FAIL never-green'))
    const { workerSession } = session()
    const result = await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle({ maxIterations: 2 }), workerSession })
    expect(result.complete).toBe(false)
    expect(fs.existsSync(lessonsPath(loopDir))).toBe(false)
  })

  it('keeps existing lessons untouched when a later run fails', async () => {
    fs.writeFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), '# Lessons\n\n- PRIOR-KEEP-9\n')
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValue(fail('FAIL brand-new-failure'))
    const { workerSession } = session()
    await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle({ maxIterations: 1 }), workerSession })
    const text = readLessons(loopDir) ?? ''
    expect(text).toContain('PRIOR-KEEP-9')
    expect(text).not.toContain('brand-new-failure')
  })

  it('feeds existing lessons into every worker prompt of the next run', async () => {
    fs.writeFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), '# Lessons\n\n- PRIOR-LESSON-42\n')
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValueOnce(fail('FAIL first')).mockReturnValueOnce(pass())
    const { prompts, workerSession } = session()
    await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle(), workerSession })
    expect(prompts).toHaveLength(2)
    for (const prompt of prompts) expect(prompt).toContain('PRIOR-LESSON-42')
  })

  it('lessons: false neither reads nor writes the file', async () => {
    fs.writeFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), '# Lessons\n\n- PRIOR-OFF-1\n')
    const before = fs.readFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), 'utf8')
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValueOnce(fail('FAIL off-gotcha')).mockReturnValueOnce(pass())
    const { prompts, workerSession } = session()
    const result = await runAgentLoop({ ctx: ctx(), bundle: bundle({ lessons: false }), workerSession })
    expect(result.complete).toBe(true)
    for (const prompt of prompts) expect(prompt).not.toContain('PRIOR-OFF-1')
    expect(fs.readFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), 'utf8')).toBe(before)
  })

  it('a worker that plants lessons.md mid-run fails that visit (frozen) and the plant is removed', async () => {
    mockedVerify.mockReturnValue(pass())
    const runIterationPrompt = vi.fn(async () => {
      fs.writeFileSync(lessonsPath(loopDir), 'PLANTED-BY-WORKER\n')
      return { text: 'done' }
    })
    const result = await runAgentLoop({
      ctx: ctx(),
      bundle: bundle({ maxIterations: 1 }),
      workerSession: { runIterationPrompt, dispose: vi.fn(async () => undefined) },
    })
    expect(result.complete).toBe(false)
    expect(readLessons(loopDir) ?? '').not.toContain('PLANTED-BY-WORKER')
  })
})
